description: This file is an ESLint configuration module written in JavaScript (with MJS format). It imports ESLint base configs, TypeScript ESLint plugin, and parser, and exports an array of configuration objects for ESLint. It specifies ignore patterns, TypeScript-specific rules, plugin usage, and language globals.

methods.name: export default
methods.description: Exports an array of ESLint configuration objects, including recommended configs, ignore patterns, TypeScript-specific rules, and language globals.
